raid_nightmare.name: 악몽의 군주
raid_nightmare.subject: A towering nightmare sovereign: a gaunt horned wraith king in tattered black and deep crimson robes over cracked obsidian armor, a crown of black thorns, many small glowing crimson eyes on a shadowy mask-face, long clawed hands holding a short curved blade of dark smoke and crimson light, wisps of black mist at the hem. Reads as the lord of nightmares. Raid boss: the largest, most imposing silhouette in the game, heavily detailed. Attack windup rears back and gathers strength; attack contact strikes forward hard with a clearly different pose; death lies collapsed flat. Keep mist, blade and claws short and inside the cell. Distinct from the style reference subject.
